## Instructors

### Hadley Wickham

Hadley Wickham is Chief Scientist at [Posit](https://posit.co), where (among other things) he leads the [tidyverse](https://www.tidyverse.org) team. He builds tools (both computational and cognitive) that make data science easier, faster, and more fun. He's the creator of packages like [ggplot2](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org), [dplyr](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org), and [devtools](https://devtools.r-lib.org) and an author of several books on R, including [R for Data Science](https://r4ds.hadley.nz) and [R Packages](https://r-pkgs.org).

[GitHub](https://github.com/hadley) · [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/hadley.nz) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hadleywickham/)

### Jenny Bryan

Jenny Bryan is a Senior Software Engineer at [Posit](https://posit.co), where she works on the tidyverse/r-lib and Positron teams. A recovering biostatistician, she takes special delight in eliminating the small agonies of data analysis. She's the creator of packages like [googlesheets4](https://googlesheets4.tidyverse.org) and [reprex](https://reprex.tidyverse.org) and an author of the book [R Packages](https://r-pkgs.org) and the [Happy Git with R](https://happygitwithr.com) guide.

[GitHub](https://github.com/jennybc) · [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/jennybryan.bsky.social)
